rebuild.label: Rebuild from the running services
rebuild.help: Coaming builds the compose file from what's running.

paste.label: I have the original compose file
paste.help: Paste it and Coaming checks it against what's running.

file.label: Original compose file
file.help: Used as you wrote it if it matches. If it doesn't, you'll see the differences first.
file.tooLarge: That file is over 1 MiB. Rebuild from the running services instead.

result.differs_one: Differs from what's running in {{count}} setting.
result.differs_other: Differs from what's running in {{count}} settings.

variables.title: Variables in your file
variables.help: Used to check your file against what's running. They are saved with the stack.
variables.missing: {{name}} has no value. Fill it in to check your file.

card.idle: Paste your file to see what will change.
card.blocked: Fix your file to see what will change.

off.empty: Paste a compose file first, or rebuild from the running services.
off.errors: Fix the errors in the pasted file first, or rebuild from the running services.

error.needsReveal: Checking your own file compares it with the values that run, which needs the reveal secrets permission. Rebuild from the running services instead.
error.invalid: The pasted file doesn't pass the check: {{reason}}
error.secretShort: A secret value is at least 4 characters. Use a longer value, or turn Secret off.
